commit.message:
Add eth: paper and Lean 4 formalization of "A 2^o(n) Time Algorithm for 3-SAT" (#31)

Adds eth/, a self-contained Lake project (Lean v4.33.1, Mathlib v4.33.1), with the paper as eth/paper.pdf.
MainResults.lean states two propositions on Mathlib's Turing machines: that the Exponential Time Hypothesis
is false, and the paper's main theorem, that one deterministic machine counts, for every k, the satisfying
assignments of k-CNF formulas within the stated time bound. Solution.lean proves both from the files under
proof/, and comparator.json names them for Comparator. The only two sorry are in Challenge.lean, which states
the two theorems without proofs for that check. eth/README.md says how to check everything.
Adds the project's row to the table of the root README.

commit.message:
Add 3sum-apsp: formalization of "Truly Subquadratic 3SUM and Truly Subcubic APSP via Triangles in Sparse Lopsided Graphs" (#28)

* CI: take lean4export's vX.Y.0 tag when a Lean patch release has no tag of its own

For a project on a stable patch release vX.Y.Z (Z > 0), if
leanprover/lean4export has no tag vX.Y.Z, the check takes the tag vX.Y.0 and
builds it with the project's toolchain. Release candidates do not fall back.
A project whose exact tag exists is checked as before. The cache key of the
tools now includes the toolchain.

* Add 3sum-apsp: Lean 4 formalization accompanying "Truly Subquadratic 3SUM and Truly Subcubic APSP via Triangles in Sparse Lopsided Graphs"

A self-contained Lake project (Lean v4.33.1, Mathlib v4.33.1) in 3sum-apsp/.
EndStatement.lean states five headline claims about programs of a word RAM;
PaperStatements.lean states further results of the paper item by item;
ThreeSumApsp/ proves them. Two Comparator configurations list the compared
theorems. 3sum-apsp/README.md says what is proved and what is not.
Adds the project's row to the table of the root README.

commit.message:
Lay out zeta23 as a Palomar template project

Bring zeta23/ into the layout of PalomarRegistry/PalomarTemplate and the
Palomar CONTRIBUTING.md requirements, so it can be submitted with the
subdirectory as the selected project and zeta23/comparator.json as the
Comparator configuration.

- Move the Comparator layer from comparator/ to the project root:
  Challenge.lean, Solution.lean, ChallengeDeps.lean and their XiPrime
  submodules; config.json -> comparator.json, config-xiprime.json ->
  comparator-xiprime.json (both gain "definition_names": []);
  PrintAxioms audits -> scripts/. Lean sources are unchanged apart from
  path mentions in comment headers (comment-stripped sources are
  byte-identical to main).
- lakefile.toml: root-level Challenge/Solution/ChallengeDeps libraries
  (roots = [...]) instead of srcDir = "comparator"; Challenge and
  Solution join the default targets, as in the template.
- formalization.yaml: add the required project.description (registry
  abstract), the template's automation/cost fields, per-statement
  alignment notes, Palomar's source-type vocabulary (paper), updated
  paths, and a note that comparator.json is the submitted configuration.
- Add scripts/verify-comparator.sh (Comparator and lean4export pinned at
  their v4.33.0-rc2 tags, Landrun/NanoDa at the template's commits, with
  a config argument), scripts/landrun-wrapper.sh,
  scripts/validate-formalization.rb, test/, Gemfile, and docbuild/
  (doc-gen4 v4.33.0-rc2).
- Add .github/workflows/zeta23-ci.yml: metadata, licence, README link and
  Landrun-wrapper checks on every change; Lean build, docs and the
  pinned Comparator run on manual dispatch (they take hours). Add
  dependabot for actions.
- README: merge comparator/README.md, add a repository map, Palomar
  submission notes and the paper's arXiv title; AUDIT.md gets a revision
  note for the relayout; root README mentions the layout.

commit.message:
CI: cache per-project .lake/build on PR runs (clean build on main)

Pull-request runs restore the most recent .lake/build for the same toolchain, manifest and lakefile and save the new one, so Lake rebuilds only changed modules; pushes to main and workflow_dispatch runs neither restore nor save. .lake/packages is not cached (Mathlib comes from lake exe cache get).

commit.message:
CI: verify only changed project folders; CI/doc-only changes run nothing (full run via workflow_dispatch)

Also allow a larger runner for the verify job via the LEAN_CI_RUNNER repository/organization variable (falls back to ubuntu-latest), and on a push with no usable before-commit diff against the merge-base with main instead of selecting every project.
